about: Mod style sections of the public gallery, after the vanilla section. Add one entry per style. mod_env and res_env name the environment variables that hold that style's scratch mod and result folder. Only generated images are shown for a style: the mod's own art is not reproduced.

styles.title: TNO style
styles.intro: The families with their own look in *The New Order: Last Days of Europe*, made from references of that mod's art, which is not reproduced here. Families TNO draws in the vanilla style are only in the vanilla section.

styles.title: TFR style
styles.intro: The families with their own look in *The Fire Rises*, made from references of that mod's art, which is not reproduced here. Families TFR draws in the vanilla style are only in the vanilla section.
